paragraphs.text:
You run like a lunatic until you think you are safe and then 
slump to the ground, exhausted.

If you took damage in the fight, there is a chance of infection. Make 
a CON roll: if you succeed, go to 343; if you fail, go to 342. If you 
avoided any damage, go to 365.
